title: Concept: Password form submits to a third-party origin
description: A password form whose action points at another origin sends what the user types to a host the application does not control. The page looks normal, the URL bar belongs to the real site, and the credentials leave before any server can validate them.
applicability: Responses that render a form containing a password field.
risk: User credentials are delivered to a third-party or attacker-controlled host, and the user cannot see the destination from the page they trust.
